question: What was the theme of the 2024 G20 Summit in Brazil?

options.text: Building a Just World and a Sustainable Planet

solution:
The correct answer is __**Building a Just World and a Sustainable Planet**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• The theme of the 2024 G20 Summit in Brazil is **"Building a Just World and a Sustainable Planet."**
 
• It emphasizes **global collaboration** to tackle issues like climate change, inequality, and sustainable development.
 
• The focus is on fostering **inclusive growth, social justice, and environmental sustainability**.
 
• Brazil, as the host nation, aims to integrate **regional and global priorities** to ensure equitable development.
 
• This theme aligns with the overarching goals of the G20, including strengthening economic resilience and promoting sustainable practices.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **G20 Overview:**

 
 
• The G20 is an international forum comprising 19 countries and the European Union, representing major economies worldwide.
 
• It addresses **global economic challenges** and promotes international financial stability.
 
• G20 members collectively account for over 80% of global GDP and 75% of international trade.
 
 
 
• **Sustainable Development Goals (SDGs):**
 
 
• The SDGs are a set of 17 global objectives adopted by the United Nations to achieve a better and sustainable future for all.
 
• They include goals like **poverty eradication, climate action, and reduced inequalities**.
 
• The 2024 G20 theme reflects commitments to SDG implementation.
 
 
 
• **Climate Change and Global Cooperation:**
 
 
• Climate change is one of the most pressing issues globally, requiring coordinated international efforts.
 
• The G20 plays a critical role in driving policies for **carbon neutrality and renewable energy adoption**.
 
 
 
• **Brazil's Role in Global Leadership:**
 
 
• Brazil has been an advocate for **sustainable development and addressing social disparities**.
 
• Hosting the 2024 G20 Summit allows Brazil to showcase its leadership in balancing economic growth with environmental protection.
